subject: Re: Quick executive intro + demo — VP/CIO attendance and standby script
messages:
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@arcadia-systems.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.example>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@arcadia-systems.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick executive intro + demo next week?

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the intro earlier this week. We got internal sign-off to move forward with a short technical demo, but our VP of Product (Anna Lim) and CIO (Marcus Hale) are only available for a 30-minute window next Wednesday, Nov 26 between 10:00–10:30 PT.

Would Redwood be able to accommodate an executive-paced 30-minute demo focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and a two-slide business case? If a VP or CIO can't attend the full window we can have a proxy, but they'd prefer to intro and ask 2–3 strategic questions live.

If possible, could you also share a 1-page runbook or script we can send to our execs so they know what to expect?

Attached: Arcadia-demo-agenda.pdf (outline)

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lee
Enterprise Sales
Arcadia Systems
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.example>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@arcadia-systems.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick executive intro + demo next week?

Hi Sara — thanks for the agenda, and congrats on getting exec availability. We can run a tight 30-minute exec-format demo on Nov 26 at 10:00 PT. Connor will lead the technical portion and I’ll do the 5-minute business intro. Ben will standby as delegate for any follow-up on procurement/questions.

To make this low-friction for Anna and Marcus, I attached a one-page "standby script" (standby-script-v1.md) that outlines the exact 30-minute flow and suggested speaking prompts for each exec. High level:
- 0–5m: Maya quick intro + 1-slide value statement
- 5–18m: Connor demo (key flows, latency numbers, fallback behavior)
- 18–25m: Use-case Q&A (2 prepped questions for CIO: data residency & routing policies)
- 25–30m: Next steps + mutual action plan

A couple of asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether Anna or Marcus will attend live or send a proxy?
2) Will Arcadia want any NDAs/POC paperwork signed before the demo?

I’ll put a calendar hold for the 30-minute slot and share a short Zoom link.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: standby-script-v1.md
From: Sara Lee <sara.lee@arcadia-systems.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.example>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@arcadia-systems.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 12:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick executive intro + demo next week?

Thanks Maya — this is great and exactly what we need. Quick answers: Anna (VP Product) will join for the first ~10 minutes to hear the value statement and ask one strategic question, then Marcus (CIO) will drop in at ~20m for the data residency Q&A. If either is delayed, Tom will cover.

We don’t need any NDA before the demo — legal said fine for a product overview. One ask: could you include the two CIO-focused slides (data routing & fallback policies) as a PDF in the calendar invite so Marcus can glance ahead?

I can confirm officially early next week but this is the working plan.

On a logistics note: can we start precisely at :00 since their window is tight?

—Sara
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.example>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@arcadia-systems.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.example>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick executive intro + demo next week?

On Mon, Nov 24, 2025 at 11:04 AM Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.example> wrote:
> I’ll put a calendar hold for the 30-minute slot and share a short Zoom link.

Thanks, Sara & Maya. We’ve finalized a trimmed deck and the two CIO slides are attached as a one-page PDF in the calendar invite. I also added a one-paragraph pre-read in the invite body that calls out the exact ask for the execs: confirm interest to move to a 6-week POC and identify a single success metric (latency p95 or cost per 1M tokens).

Standby plan if an exec is delayed or drops:
- If VP misses first 10m: Maya covers the 1-slide value and we extend Q&A by 3m (compress technical flow).
- If CIO arrives late: Connor will run the data/regulatory slides during 18–22m and follow with async answers to any detailed questions.
- If both execs unavailable: proceed with technical walkthrough and agree immediate next step (POC scoping) with Tom as proxy.

See attached: Arcadia-demo-agenda.pdf (updated), standby-script-v1.md

Look forward to run-through Wednesday at 10:00 PT — we’ll start promptly.

—Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
